data.long_meaning: Derived from the Arabic word ‘mirr’, meaning ‘star’ or ‘light’. The name Miral is often used to describe someone who is a shining light, a guiding star, or someone who inspires and illuminates the way for others. In Islamic tradition, the star is a symbol of guidance and protection. The name Miral carries the meaning “Star, Light, Guiding” and is chosen by families in Islamic traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Arabic tradition and is also used in Arabic, Urdu, Persian. Parents who choose Miral usually hope their child will grow to embody star, light, guiding and live with faith, good character and purpose.
